title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Breaking Through Stone Wall Comforter design 1
description:
Transform your bedroom with this custom trucker comforter set from Jeminise, designed especially for semi-truck enthusiasts and road legends. Featuring a bold digital illustration of a semi-truck breaking through a stone wall, this modern bedding set brings a dynamic and stylish energy to any room decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Add your own custom text with one text input field to make it truly unique.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester microfiber fabric that is soft, breathable, lightweight, and eco-friendly.
  • Vibrant Colors: Advanced digital printing methods ensure colors remain vibrant and resist fading without harmful chemicals or dyes.
  • Included Components: Includes 1 comforter or duvet cover with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick-drying, and recommended to wash in a mesh laundry bag.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Cool Red Truck
Pattern Cartoon
Style Modern
Theme Trucker
Seasons All
Customization 1 text input
Care Instructions Machine Wash
